anchor.snippet: test('native scrollbars navigate terminals, editors and overflowing lists with system wheel signs', { timeout: 45000 }, async () => {

entries.note: Exercise native pointer/wheel dispatch using read-only bar geometry, real PTY output, an overflowing file tree and a two-axis long editor. Assert oldest/live and editor endpoints, track paging, signed precise FLIPPED motion, unchanged document bytes/revision, no PTY input on bar actions and no-overflow hiding. Use the Tree toolbar to reveal the tree when its header is outside the tab strip; never bypass overflow navigation by selecting a hidden control. Tree dragging qualifies the shared upstream list scrollbar path. Tests own and clean only their fixture service/window/processes.
